facts.text: I am thinking of buying a new keyboard with more features and sounds than my current Yamaha P-125.
I am considering newer keyboard models from Korg and Roland.
My budget for the new keyboard is around $1,000.
I mostly play classical and jazz.
I am looking for a keyboard with a good piano sound.
I have been thinking about a keyboard with weighted keys, but I am not sure if it is necessary.
I think I will try out the Korg B1 and the Roland FP-10.
I was thinking about getting a new guitar amp before trying the Korg B1 and Roland FP-10.
I have been using my Fender Mustang I V2 for practice.
I want a guitar amp with more power and better sound quality than my Fender Mustang I V2.
I am thinking of getting an amp suitable for both practice and small gigs.
I have been playing my Taylor GS Mini more frequently since I got my Fender Mustang I V2.
I think a more powerful amp would bring out the full potential of my Taylor GS Mini.
I think I will try out the Fender Acoustic 40 and Fishman Loudbox Mini.
I will consider the AER Compact 60, but it is a bit above my budget.
I just got back from Joe's shop.
I took my Taylor GS Mini to the guitar tech for servicing today.
The action on my Taylor GS Mini had been a bit high and it was causing discomfort in my left hand.
The action on my Taylor GS Mini is now perfect.
My Taylor GS Mini feels more comfortable to play now.
I would love to explore effects pedals or accessories to enhance my sound.
I have been thinking about getting a compressor pedal to even out my dynamics and add some sustain.
I want recommendations for compressors or other pedals that would complement my Taylor GS Mini and Fender Mustang I V2.

keyphrases: Taylor GS Mini action high left hand discomfort
effects pedals for Taylor GS Mini and Fender Mustang I V2
